context: Naoko joins Sachiko at a senior community gathering.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: おばさん、こういう集まり、楽しい。
lines.en: You know, I really love gatherings like this.
lines.style: Warm, genuine opening. A beat of pause before the main thought — she's feeling it. Soft and present, not performing, just speaking from the center of the moment.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.en: Everyone here is so kind, aren't they.
lines.style: Gentle, agreeing tone. A quiet nod in the voice. Philosophical — she's noticed something true about people. Tender trailing-off that invites reflection.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: It makes me happy when my circle of friends keeps growing.
lines.style: Loud and generous — Naoko lets her affection show. A little laugh threaded through. Not performing gratitude, but radiating it. Open-hearted.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 一緒に、過ごす時間、大切。
lines.en: The time we spend together — it's what matters most.
lines.style: Slow, deliberate. Weight on 「大切」 — Sachiko speaking from long life experience. Quiet wisdom. No rush. Each word lands with care.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: I hope we'll keep going forward like this.
lines.style: Warm, earnest promise. Soft on the opening, steady through the middle. A gentle hand reaching forward. No doubt in her voice — just hope and affection.
